description: This file contains utility functions for SQL store operations in the focalboard server, including database connection setup, error handling, and schema retrieval.

classes.name: ErrInvalidDBType
classes.description: Error type for unsupported database types

methods.name: CloseRows
methods.description: Closes sql.Rows and logs error if occurs

methods.name: IsErrNotFound
methods.description: Checks if an error is a 'not found' error

methods.name: MarshalJSONB
methods.description: Marshals data into JSON, optionally prepending a binary indicator

methods.name: PrepareNewTestDatabase
methods.description: Prepares a new test database connection string based on environment variables

methods.name: newErrInvalidDBType
methods.description: Creates an error for unsupported database types

methods.name: deleteBoardRecord
methods.description: Deletes a board record without deleting child records (unit testing only)

methods.name: deleteBlockRecord
methods.description: Deletes a block record without deleting child records (unit testing only)

methods.description: Returns SQL cast expression for integer values based on database type

methods.name: GetSchemaName
methods.description: Retrieves the current schema name for supported databases
